predeclared_plan.startup_pair_rationale: Fixed before standalone candidate timings: prior separate experiment exposed substantial startup RSS/THP variability; retain every pair, no cohort selection.
predeclared_plan.timing_policy: Interleaved fresh processes; no owned build, test, or profiler overlap; exact output checksums. Separate diagnostic runs.
predeclared_plan.regression_gate: Median paired candidate/baseline >1.03 and bootstrap95CI excludes parity in slower direction, independently by component/metric; rework/park if meaningful regression.

format_only_postbuild_edit.change: Move cfg(test) numeric_array_tests module declaration after native_array_local_tests to satisfy rustfmt ordering. No non-test source changed. Full validation/build used source snapshot; final source differs only in test module order.

measurement_policy.wall_clock: wait4 helper CLOCK_MONOTONIC around one direct engine child; Python perf_counter also records taskset/helper overhead
measurement_policy.child_resource_usage: Linux wait4 rusage for one direct engine child; ru_maxrss is per-child KiB
measurement_policy.internal_timer: elapsed_ms/internal_ms emitted by the workload; absent for actual EJS source; webgl includes five samples per kernel
measurement_policy.bootstrap: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples of candidate/baseline ratios; 95% percentile interval

diagnostics.note: Separate diagnostic executions with TRUST_JS_PERF_METRICS=1; excluded from all timing summaries.
